title: Patti's Mussels à la Marinière
description: Patti's mussels à la marinière recipe steams mussels in wine, garlic, parsley, tomatoes, and onions. It will make you think you're in the south of France.

steps.text: Place mussels in a large bowl with enough cold water to cover; soak to remove any dirt or sand, about 20 minutes.

Heat olive oil in a large stockpot over medium-low heat. Add garlic; cook 1 minute, but do not brown. Add tomatoes and green onions; cook until almost tender. Stir in wine, parsley, and margarine; bring to a boil. Boil until liquid has reduced by half, about 15 minutes; season with salt and black pepper.
Add mussels to the pot, cover, and cook until shells are opened, about 10 minutes. Transfer mussels and sauce to a large serving bowl, discarding any mussels with unopened shells.

video.description: Cooking mussels at home can seem intimidating at first, but it’s actually one of the easiest ways to make a delicious, quick dinner fresh from the sea. (It’s also a great way to entertain on a budget!) In this video, Nicole shows you not only how to cook mussels, but also how to clean mussels in three easy steps for the tastiest results. This effortlessly elegant dish features a heavenly broth made with white wine, roma tomatoes, and lots of garlic that will transport you to an outdoor cafe in the south of France. Don’t forget to serve it up with some crusty bread to soak up all that goodness – it’s the best part!
